module.name: BNK Prerequisites
module.description: Creates BNK namespaces, FAR image pull secrets, and downloads the BNK manifest to parse component versions. Foundation module — everything else in the BNK stack depends on it.

required.name: cne_pull_secret
required.description: F5 FAR registry credentials. Accepts a bare base64-encoded service account JSON key, or a base64-encoded dockerconfigjson. Format is auto-detected. Bind to a project secret in the deploy form.

optional.name: forge_kubeconfig_content
optional.description: Kubeconfig YAML content. Auto-injected by BNK-Forge from the selected cluster. Set manually for standalone usage.

optional.name: operator_namespace
optional.description: Operator namespace — FLO, License CR, OTEL/CWC. Gold-standard split: f5-cne-core. CNEInstance + CNE controller live in instance_namespace.

optional.name: utils_namespace
optional.description: Namespace for utility components (e.g. IPAM if deployed separately).

optional.name: gateway_namespace
optional.description: Namespace for Gateway API resources (Gateway, HTTPRoute, etc.).

optional.name: instance_namespace
optional.description: Instance namespace — CNEInstance CR, cloud-network CM, NADs, IRSA SA, CNE controller. Gold-standard split: f5-cne-system (awsbnkctl bnkconst.InstanceNamespace). When set and different from operator_namespace, creates this namespace + far-secret here. Empty collapses onto operator_namespace (legacy single-namespace mode).

optional.name: bnk_manifest_version
optional.description: BNK manifest version to download from FAR (e.g. 2.3.0-3.2598.3-0.0.170). Must start with X.Y.Z- format.

optional.name: cluster_name
optional.description: Name of the Kubernetes cluster. Auto-wired from the cloud cluster module when available.

key_outputs.name: operator_namespace
key_outputs.description: Operator namespace name (FLO, License CR, OTEL/CWC). Gold-standard: f5-cne-core.

key_outputs.name: instance_namespace
key_outputs.description: Instance namespace name (CNEInstance CR, cloud-network CM, NADs, IRSA SA, CNE controller). Gold-standard: f5-cne-system.

key_outputs.name: far_secret_name
key_outputs.description: Name of the FAR image pull secret (always 'far-secret').

key_outputs.name: flo_version
key_outputs.description: FLO Helm chart version parsed from the BNK manifest.

key_outputs.name: component_versions
key_outputs.description: All component versions parsed from the BNK manifest.

key_outputs.name: cert_manager_version
key_outputs.description: F5 cert-manager version from the manifest (informational — the cert-manager module uses its own version).

key_outputs.name: prerequisites_ready
key_outputs.description: Gate output — true when namespaces, secrets, and manifest parsing are all complete.
